name: Akron
takeaway: Akron's Dynegy contract expired June 30, 2026. No successor program confirmed — accounts are back on Ohio Edison standard supply or pending re-bid.
hook: Akron's city aggregation with Dynegy ran out at the end of June — do you know what rate those accounts flipped to?
notes: Current supplier: Dynegy at 9.24¢/kWh. Term ends approximately June 2026. Ohio Edison territory. Verify exact term end date and new program rate. Note: Cuyahoga Falls and Wadsworth are municipal electric utilities — not eligible for competitive electric supply.

name: Green
takeaway: Green City's Dynegy contract (shared with Akron) expired June 30, 2026. Accounts have lost price protection.
hook: Green is on the same Dynegy contract as Akron — that term ended in June. Have your accounts there figured out what they're on now?
notes: Green City, Summit County. Same Dynegy/Ohio Edison program as Akron. Term end approximately June 2026. Strong commercial/retail growth on SR-241.

name: Medina County
takeaway: Medina County aggregation program (Dynegy) repriced from 6.05¢ to 9.50¢ in May 2026 — a 57% increase. Accounts are locked in through June 2028 but can opt out individually.
hook: Medina County aggregation just jumped 57% — from 6.05 to 9.50 cents — and accounts are locked in through 2028. Most don't know they can opt out. That's the conversation.
notes: Medina County aggregation program (separate from NOPEC). Rate: 9.50¢/kWh, confirmed active May 2026 through June 2028. Ohio Edison territory. Accounts that opted out of the county program may be on a higher standard offer rate. Cities and villages are ineligible. This is the unincorporated county program.

name: Stark County (Unincorporated / Remaining)
takeaway: No county-wide program. Unincorporated Stark County is split by township.
notes: Jackson Township (Stark) and Perry Township (Stark) are Dynegy programs. Plain Township and Paris Township (Stark) are NOPEC members.

name: Kent / Portage County
notes: Kent and surrounding Portage County communities are NOPEC members. Ohio Edison territory. University/commercial mix in Kent proper.

name: Clinton
takeaway: Clinton (Summit County) has no township aggregation program. It sits in the Akron/Canton orbit — accounts are on Ohio Edison standard supply with no bulk price protection.
hook: Clinton doesn't have an aggregation program, so those accounts are on Ohio Edison standard. The nearest talking points are Akron's Dynegy contract expiring this month and Medina County's new 9.50¢ program — worth checking if they have a supplier or just riding utility.
notes: Village of Clinton, Summit County (not Clinton County). Located near 2534 W Comet Rd area. Ohio Edison service area. No municipal or township aggregation program found. Sits in Akron/Canton commercial orbit. Use Medina County pain story or Akron renewal story when prospecting in this corridor.
